items.title: Apollo limits redemptions as withdrawal requests hit 14.7% - Bloomberg
items.summary: Investing.com -- Apollo Global Management LLC (NYSE:APO) is limiting redemptions from its flagship private credit fund for the third consecutive quarter, as investors continue a broader retreat from the direct lending market. The private equity firm notified shareholders on Tuesday that it will cap quarterly withdrawals from Apollo Debt Solutions BDC at 5% of outstanding shares after receiving redemption requests totaling 14.7% of its stock, according to Bloomberg reporting on a letter to invest

items.title: This is Not Bitcoin’s Cycle
items.summary: Last cycle mainstreamed Bitcoin. This one may belong to Zcash and alts with real revenue, buybacks, and newly opening U.S. markets.

items.title: If You Own IBIT, This Bitcoin Fund’s 13% Yield Deserves a Second Look
items.summary: IBIT gives you Bitcoin exposure without a penny of cash flow, and BlackRock quietly launched a companion fund that flips that equation by converting Bitcoin's famous volatility into monthly income. Whether that tradeoff costs you more than it pays depends on what Bitcoin does next.

items.title: Bitcoin ETFs Just Pulled In $1 Billion in a Day as Investors Break Even
items.summary: Spot Bitcoin ETFs just logged their biggest single-day haul in nearly a year, and the surge flipped the average investor from underwater to break-even. Whether that crossover signals a rally or a selling trigger depends on what happens next.

items.title: Inside Coinbase’s $250 Billion Playbook for Post-Quantum Bitcoin Custody
items.summary: Head of cryptography Yehuda Lindell says the exchange is designing custody that can adapt to whatever post-quantum signing scheme Bitcoin adopts.

items.title: BlackRock, Vanguard Muni ETFs See Record Inflows After Bond Rout
items.summary: The two largest municipal bond exchange-traded funds just recorded their largest weekly inflows ever, shortly after a bond rout fueled outflows in other muni funds.

items.summary: The funds pulled in more on Monday than across the whole of last week, when they posted the weakest net inflow of their history.
